xml.brief: Retrieve information on a single geocache

desc.p: Retrieve information on a single geocache. This method delegates to the services/caches/geocache method for comprehensive cache data.

req.name: cache_code
req.p: Unique code of the geocache to retrieve.

opt.name: fields
opt.p: Pipe-separated list of field names to include in the response. See services/caches/geocache documentation for the complete list of available fields.

opt.name: owner_fields
opt.p: Pipe-separated list of user fields to include in the owner section. For valid field names, see services/users/user method documentation.

opt.name: langpref
opt.p: Pipe-separated list of ISO 639-1 language codes indicating the order of preference for language selection in fields like name and description.

opt.name: lpc
opt.p: Log entries per cache - the number of logs returned in the latest_logs field. Use "all" for all entries, or an integer. Only used if latest_logs is requested in fields.

opt.name: log_fields
opt.p: Pipe-separated list of log fields to include in the latest_logs section.

opt.name: log_user_fields
opt.p: Pipe-separated list of user fields to include in log entries.

opt.name: user_logs_only
opt.p: Boolean. If true, only logs from the authenticated user will be included in latest_logs.

opt.name: my_location
opt.p: Reference point for distance/bearing calculations in "lat|lon" format. Required when accessing distance and bearing fields.

opt.name: user_uuid
opt.p: User ID for accessing user-specific fields like is_found, is_watched, is_ignored. Not required with Level 3 Authentication.

returns.p: A dictionary of cache fields you have selected. Refer to services/caches/geocache documentation for complete field descriptions and examples.
If the cache does not exist or is not accessible, HTTP 400 error is returned.
